'''Jolus''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] technician who was employed by [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] forces during the [[Battle of Balmorra (Galactic Wars)|fighting]] to retake the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Sobrik]] on [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]].<ref name="TOR" />
